question: By what percentage of the bare-Al value did the carbon layer reduce the sodium nucleation overpotential?
rendered: The carbon layer reduced the sodium nucleation overpotential from 19 mV (bare Al) to 12 mV. This is a reduction of 7 mV, which is approximately 36.8% of the bare-Al value.
